items.title: Pensions industry calls for rise to auto-enrolment contributions
items.summary: According to Professional Pensions, the pensions industry has urged the government to implement a clear timetable for increasing minimum auto-enrolment contributions.

items.title: Texas Attorney General sues OpenAI over consumer protection and safety concerns
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and founder Sam Altman, alleging the company deceived and harmed residents.

items.title: Amynta Group completes acquisition of specialty MGU Southern States Underwriters
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, insurance services provider Amynta Group has finalised its purchase of Southern States Underwriters and SSC Insurance Agency.

items.title: The Hartford reports 23% rise in third-quarter net income
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, the US insurer posted net income of about $1.3 billion for the third quarter of 2026, alongside higher catastrophe losses and growth in written premiums.

items.title: Hampden Risk Partners appoints Danny Milnes as Head of Exposure Management
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, hampden Risk Partners, operating through Syndicate 2689 at Lloyd's, has appointed Danny Milnes to lead its exposure management function.

items.title: FCA issues warning over unauthorized clone firm pinnaclesweb.com
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has warned consumers against dealing with pinnaclesweb.com, an unauthorized clone of genuine firm Pinnacle Wealth Management LLP.
